feature: Customer-scoped enrollment token (expiring, multi-use) passed to the installer
notes: Comet install token is single-use; Cove site installer is multi-use up to 100 devices; Datto REG_TOKEN; Axcient TOKENID; Acronis reg-token. CryoBackup token binds customer + policy so a device needs zero console clicks.

feature: Silent install with token and server URL (MSI /qn and EXE /S)
original: Comet, Cove, MSP360, Datto, Axcient, Acronis, Veeam
notes: One canonical CLI syntax (Axcient 2.x vs 3.x switch split is an avoid). Veeam silent switches [unverified]. Packaging per engine §5.7.

feature: Console enrollment wizard that generates the RMM deployment script
notes: Cove Add Device wizard; MSP360 generates a PowerShell silent-install script; Comet publishes RMM sample scripts. Output follows the idempotent/dry-run script shape and works in any RMM.

feature: Server-side provisioning at enroll: repo init, gateway login, escrowed repo key
notes: Replaces Comet Storage Template. Admin path inits the repo; bcrypt htpasswd entry hot-reloads (engine §3.1); key escrow in security area. Endpoint never receives the storage credential.

feature: Stable device ID used as restic --host (independent of hostname), duplicate/cloned identity detection, editable friendly name
notes: Engine §1.7: users rename PCs and reimages reuse names; changing --host breaks parent selection and forget grouping. Comet hardware-ID identity breaks on cloned images (multiple devices detected as one); refuse or force re-enroll.

feature: Retire device: revoke gateway login, stop schedules, keep data until retention expires; archive state stays restorable
notes: Comet Revoke; IDrive Block/Archive; Cove Expires-on. Retired devices drop out of unseen alarms but remain restorable. Retire is not delete.

feature: Pending-approval enrollment (lobby) for installs without a valid token
notes: Comet lobby shows Unregistered until an admin clicks Register; MSP360 Pending until Authorize. Never auto-trust an unknown device; token path is the default.

feature: Replace device: new hardware adopts the existing repo and history
notes: Comet F08 restores to the new device then copies the item. CryoBackup rebinds identity so history continues and re-issues the gateway login; --private-repos blocks cross-user reads (engine §3.1) so adoption is the only device-side path.

feature: Large first backup resumable inside an initial-backup window
notes: Axcient initial backup start/end window. restic never writes a partial snapshot but reuses uploaded packs via index checkpoints (engine §1.11), so interrupted seeds resume.

feature: Pre-seed first backup from a local repository or shipped drive
notes: IDrive 360 Express ships a drive. Feasible only by building the repo locally and copying it to the gateway path [unverified]. WAN re-seed is the known migration cost from incumbent tools.

feature: Policy object per customer: schedule, selection, retention, throttle, thresholds
original: Comet, Cove, Datto, Axcient, Veeam, IDrive, MSP360
notes: Core of the MSP loop. Policies are per customer with per-device override (data model section).

feature: Per-device override: sparse partial override with reason, shown as overridden
notes: MSP360 global>company>computer inherit chain; Axcient per-device alert override. Comet (Custom) inline copy diverges invisibly - store a sparse override, never a copy.

feature: Default policy applied to new customers and devices
notes: Comet Default Policy; Cove default profile 24 Hour RPO makes a new device compliant on day one.

feature: Policy edit states its blast radius: live reference to existing devices, device count shown before save
notes: Comet defaults apply to new users/items only unless Update existing devices is ticked - a known surprise for MSPs. CryoBackup keeps one live reference and no per-object copies.

feature: Bulk-assign policy to selected devices or customers
notes: Comet UI has no multi-select apply (API only) - avoid.

feature: Policy templates by device class (laptop vs desktop)
notes: Axcient workstation vs server defaults; Cove Documents device; Datto business-hours default. Laptop template = interval-in-window + catch-up + conditions.

feature: Policy versioning: device reports applied version, drift shown
notes: IDrive plan propagation status Applied / Pending / Failed.

feature: Mandatory exclusions merged into every device selection
notes: Comet policy mandatory file and folder exclusions.

feature: Per-customer notification overrides with inherit (global > customer > device)
notes: MSP360 Settings > Notifications overridable per company.

feature: Agent-local permissions: lock local edits, per-customer feature toggles, per-setting lock mode
notes: Comet Prevent/Hide flags and 5-state modes; UrBackup client-side change permissions; MSP360 agent options. Default locked; one operator needs a per-field lock flag, not five states.

feature: Interval-in-window schedule with due-ness recomputed from last success (no stored next-run)
notes: UrBackup due = no qualifying success newer than the interval, re-evaluated continuously; Datto business hours every 2 h; Axcient interval in window. Agent owns the scheduler (ADR).

feature: Missed-run catch-up on reconnect or boot, default ON, with catch-up/skip selector
notes: Comet If-the-last-job-was-Missed; Veeam Backup-once-powered-on vs Skip-backup with 15-min tolerance; IDrive 30-min grace. Acronis ships run-missed-at-startup default OFF - avoid.

feature: Run-on-wake: resume from sleep triggers a due check
notes: Needs AcceptPowerEvent in x/sys/windows/svc; kardianos/service drops power events (engine §5.1-5.2). Modern Standby can delay the start by minutes (Veeam). PBT/WTS constants defined locally [UNCERTAIN export].

feature: Run-on-start with startup delay
notes: Comet fires on service start if uptime under 10 min; UrBackup startup_backup_delay (default 0).

feature: Backup-window mini-language (Mon-Fri/8-18;Sat,Sun/0-24) with visual editor; windows gate starts and never stop a running backup
notes: UrBackup windows checked at queue and again at start, never kill. Acronis kills a running job at a prohibited hour - avoid. Per-window interval override (1 h day, 4 h night) is a UrBackup extra.

feature: Static upload/download limit (--limit-upload / --limit-download)
original: Comet, Cove, MSP360, IDrive, UrBackup, Acronis, Axcient, Datto
notes: Engine §1.6: KiB/s, fixed for the whole run.

feature: Skip if already running (one restic job per device)
notes: Comet status Skipped; UrBackup serialises per group.

feature: Retry failed runs with exponential backoff
notes: UrBackup waits 20 min x 2^failures; Comet retry count and delay (24.6.6).

feature: Start jitter to spread fleet load, plus fleet concurrency cap
notes: Comet random job delay up to 300 min; UrBackup max simultaneous backups (10). Gateway throughput under 200 clients is unmeasured (engine §3.3) and rclone serve has no metrics (§3.1), so the console budgets via jitter and a token queue.

feature: Resume after reboot or crash mid-run
notes: restic has no partial snapshot; the next due check reuses uploaded packs through index checkpoints (engine §1.11).

feature: Console Back-up-now (bypasses window and conditions) and cancel running backup
notes: restic exits 130 and removes its lock on cancel (engine §5.4). Requires the command queue (console area). Offers force rescan of unchanged files (Comet rescan; restic --force, the only change-detection flag honoured on Windows, engine §1.4).

feature: Fixed time-of-day schedules and hourly/monthly/yearly/once frequencies
original: Comet, Cove, MSP360, IDrive, Veeam, Acronis
notes: Maps onto the same due-ness engine (due once the slot passes without a success). Veeam daily-only ceiling is an avoid.

feature: Scheduled throttle windows (limit varies by day/time)
original: Comet, Cove, MSP360, UrBackup, Datto, Axcient
notes: Engine §6 / §1.6: not engine-native; agent restarts restic at window boundaries and loses only the in-flight pack (index checkpoints keep progress).

feature: Start-condition framework: conditions delay a start, never cancel it, with run-anyway-after-N fallback; Wi-Fi/VPN gating
notes: Acronis 8 conditions all must hold, fallback label [unverified]; Veeam restricts by VPN/Wi-Fi. Best laptop idea in the sweep: delay, never skip the SLA.

feature: Battery floor (no start below X percent unless on AC)
notes: Only Acronis and IDrive document it. Cove, MSP360, Datto, Axcient, Veeam, UrBackup: not documented (UrBackup needs a failing script workaround).

feature: Metered-connection deferral (defer, never fail)
notes: Veeam fails the scheduled job when no cache exists - avoid. Windows cost-API access from Go [unverified].

feature: Run-time limit (cancel if exceeding N hours) and long-run alarm
notes: MSP360 stop-condition-for-the-long-backup; Veeam max-allowed-job-duration alarm.

feature: Prevent sleep during a run (best effort)
notes: SetThreadExecutionState via kernel32 lazy DLL (export in x/sys unverified); Modern Standby may ignore it from a service, so lid-closed backup is not promised (engine §5.1). Comet prevents sleep automatically since 18.3.9.

feature: Console-owned time-boxed pause (1/2/4/8/24 h or indefinite) with reason, visible as a state
notes: Datto: retention still runs on paused devices; Axcient Parked skipped by digest. UrBackup tray pause is in-memory and invisible to the server - avoid; local user pause only if shown server-side.

feature: Idle vs in-use throttle split (keyboard/mouse activity)
notes: IDrive auto-pause 25 percent when the PC is in use; Datto idle/in-use limits. Needs a service-side input-idle check [unverified].

feature: Wake from sleep to start a scheduled backup (wake timers)
notes: Needs Allow-wake-timers; not Modern Standby; no promise (engine §5.1). Acronis default Disabled; Veeam via global setting.

feature: Pre/post run hooks
notes: Runs as SYSTEM: policy-gated and audited. Servers with databases: dump first, then back up the dumps (engine §6).

feature: Event triggers (lock, log-off, rate limit no-more-often-than-N) and post-run power action
notes: Veeam events include when-backup-target-is-connected, irrelevant to a network gateway.

feature: Sub-hourly interval (15-60 min) with --skip-if-unchanged and --no-scan
notes: Engine §6: near-continuous by interval; scan cost grows with file count.

feature: Continuous / real-time data protection (CDP)
notes: Engine §6: snapshot-per-run, no USN-journal integration. Use the sub-hourly interval row. UrBackup continuous backup is vestigial in 2.x.

feature: Path-based selection with tree picker and volume selection (fixed NTFS only)
original: Comet, Cove, MSP360, Veeam, UrBackup, IDrive, Axcient
notes: Skip ReFS/FAT/removable by default (Axcient). Engine §1.2: minimum Windows 10 / Server 2016.

feature: Selection presets: all user profiles, Documents/Desktop, fixed drives; auto-selection by extension tier
notes: IDrive PROFILEDEFAULTFOLDERS and CurrentProfile macros; UrBackup default dirs; Cove Automatic File Selection and extension-based Documents device.

feature: Exclude patterns (glob; --iexclude for case-insensitive NTFS)
original: Comet, Cove, MSP360, Datto, Veeam, UrBackup, IDrive
notes: Engine §1.5: ** must be a whole component; ! cannot re-include inside an excluded dir; ~ not expanded. Never emit --one-file-system on Windows (fails immediately).

feature: Published default exclusion baseline (temp, Recycle Bin, pagefile, hiberfil, swapfile, System Volume Information, FilesNotToBackup key)
notes: Only Veeam publishes a concrete list; Cove reads the FilesNotToBackup registry key. Show the list in the console, editable.

feature: Skip online-only cloud placeholders (--exclude-cloud-files), default ON
notes: Engine §1.1: required for workstation profiles (VSS problems and forced downloads). MSP360 Do-not-back-up-On-Demand-files is selected by default.

feature: NTFS security descriptors, attributes, creation time and EAs preserved
notes: Engine §1.3: since restic 0.17.0; full SD needs SeBackupPrivilege (held by LocalSystem, §5.3). Comet gates this behind extra-permissions option (24.6.2).

feature: Include filters
notes: Exclusions beat inclusions (Datto, Veeam). Implement as selection roots plus excludes.

feature: Exclusion presets and rule helpers (browser caches, VM images, installers; size limit; cache-dir tags; marker files; system/hidden toggle)
notes: IDrive default extension list (.exe/.dll/.ost/VM images) is opinionated - ship as opt-in presets with a visible diff. Engine §1.5 flags: --exclude-larger-than, --exclude-caches, --exclude-if-present.

feature: Per-path flags: required vs optional, require snapshot, follow symlinks
notes: Missing source path exits 3 in restic 0.19 (engine §1.10); optional downgrades it to a warning.

feature: Outlook OST/PST handling
notes: OST skipped by Windows via FilesNotToSnapshot under VSS (engine §1.1); PST locked without VSS.

feature: Network share backup with stored credentials
notes: UNC path, no VSS; service runs as SYSTEM so credentials must be stored - HIPAA and secret-handling risk.

feature: EFS-encrypted files
notes: restic EFS behaviour is not covered in the engine sheet [unverified]; Comet requires an EFS key-export confirmation.

feature: Alternate Data Streams
notes: Engine §1.3: restic PR #4614 closed unmerged; ADS silently omitted (Zone.Identifier and app metadata lost). State it in docs.

feature: Junction / reparse-point contents (symlinks are recorded, not followed)
notes: Engine §1.3: junctions give target path only, never contents; 0.19.1 junction warnings must be lab-tested [UNCERTAIN].

feature: Retention rules from restic forget keep-* and keep-within, OR-combined
original: Comet, Cove, Veeam, Acronis, MSP360, Axcient
notes: Engine §1.14. Comet 11 range types map onto keep-last / -daily / -weekly / -monthly / -yearly / -within; newer-than-date is not native. Pair every policy with keep-within: fake snapshots can push real ones out of keep windows.

feature: Named retention presets plus custom rule editor (e.g. 30 days, 1 year GFS, 7 years)
notes: Datto fixed tiers (90 d / 1 y / 3 y / 7 y) with published thinning; Axcient Recommended / Space Saving; Comet GFS built from three rules. Presets remove a class of misconfiguration; custom editor is the escape hatch.

feature: Retention counts days a backup actually ran, not calendar days
notes: restic keep-daily counts only periods that contain a snapshot, so a missed day does not consume a slot (engine §1.14): native.

feature: Last successful snapshot is never pruned
notes: restic refuses to delete the last snapshot of a group without --unsafe-allow-remove-all (engine §1.14).

feature: Retention executed server-side only (forget then prune as two invocations)
notes: Agent has no delete rights (append-only). Admin host runs forget (JSON) then prune (no JSON, engine §1.9) per device repo in a loop; prune takes an exclusive lock.

feature: Prune cadence per storage target, provider-aware (default quarterly where minimum-storage billing applies)
notes: Engine §4.2: Wasabi 90-day minimum bills early deletes; prune rarely, raise --max-unused, use --repack-cacheable-only. MSP360 Intelligent Retention stretches retention to the provider minimum.

feature: Retention or prune failure raised as a device alarm
notes: Comet RetentionError shows on the vault, not the job list - surface it per device. Prune has no JSON: parse exit code and stderr.

feature: Retention preview (calendar of what survives) from forget --dry-run --json
notes: Cove calendar preview; restic forget JSON returns keep/remove reasons (engine §1.9, §1.14).

feature: Prune safety guard: refuse when forget would remove more than X percent or the last snapshot
notes: Catches future-dated snapshots, clock skew and snapshot-flood attacks (engine §1.14, §3.2).

feature: Delete a single snapshot (audited admin action)
notes: forget by ID on the admin host; Comet has a policy flag to forbid it.

feature: Keep-tag exemption (legal hold / archive a snapshot)
notes: restic --keep-tag is native. UrBackup archival; IDrive legal hold on immutable snapshots.

feature: Min/max counts with emergency floor
notes: Object storage has no disk-full event; emulate with keep-last + keep-within.

feature: Cold-tier GFS archive via restic copy into a second repo
notes: Engine §6: native cold tiers not v1 (storage-class flags hit every object incl. locks; Glacier-class objects break prune). copy needs matching chunker params.

feature: S3-compatible object storage behind the gateway
notes: Engine §4: Wasabi, Backblaze B2 via S3 API (not native b2:), IDrive e2. Set --s3-no-check-bucket on the gateway remote (§4.4).

feature: One restic repo and one gateway login per device (--private-repos)
notes: Engine §2.7: bounds lock contention, client RAM, key blast radius and prune cost to one device. Repo URL rest:https://gw/user/; mismatched URL user is 403 (§3.1). Price: no cross-device dedup.

feature: Append-only gateway (rclone serve restic --append-only)
notes: Engine §3.2: DELETE 403 except locks; overwrite 403. Use the CLI flag not the env var; lab-test that client forget fails. Analogues: Cove Fortified Copies, Axcient AirGap (vendor-side).

feature: Single storage credential on gateway/admin hosts only; separate admin path with delete rights
notes: Engine §3.4: gateway host + rclone.conf are the trust boundary; forget/prune/check run via a non-append-only path never exposed to clients.

feature: TLS 1.2+ at the gateway, bcrypt htpasswd, hot reload
notes: Engine §3.1: rclone --min-tls-version defaults to tls1.0 - set tls1.2.

feature: Client-side compression and chunk-level dedup inside the device repo
notes: Repo format v2, zstd auto; per-run --compression off / fastest / better / max (engine §2.6, §1.6). Dedup scope is the repo. Veeam compression and block-size tiers map to this setting only.

feature: Usage tracking per device and customer (restic stats raw-data, provider metrics)
notes: Cove Selected Size vs Used Storage; Comet Stored Current vs Historic. Needs admin-path stats runs.

feature: Incremental-forever: no periodic fulls, every snapshot self-contained, no chain to break
notes: Cove TrueDelta; MSP360 Forever Forward Incremental (Windows only); Axcient chain-free. restic snapshots are views over deduped blobs, so no synthetic-full or reseed jobs exist.

feature: Customer-scoped bucket or prefix for cost attribution
notes: Engine §2.7 recommends bucket/prefix per customer. Moving a device between customers does not move its repo path.

feature: Soft quota per customer/device with threshold alarms
notes: Axcient disk-usage 80% alerts; MSP360 storage report.

feature: Bucket versioning plus lifecycle window as ransomware backstop
notes: Engine §4.5 v1 recommendation: provider versioning (B2 hide + lifecycle, Wasabi/IDrive versioning) plus gateway host hardening.

feature: Repo integrity check on schedule (restic check, optional --read-data-subset)
notes: Engine §1.15: check takes an exclusive lock; read-data costs egress. Comet deep verify; Axcient cache verify every 24 h.

feature: Stale-lock cleanup and repo repair from the console
notes: Engine §2.1: locks go stale at 30 min; a hostile client can delete locks in its own repo. Comet unlock / reindex device actions.

feature: Hard quota enforcement at the gateway
notes: Engine §3.1: rclone serve restic has no --max-size; rest-server does (§3.5). MSP360 suspends backups at the limit.

feature: Other targets: local disk / NAS via rest-server, SFTP, Azure, GCS via rclone
notes: Engine §3.5: rest-server adds quota, metrics and upload verification but needs a second off-site copy. B2 native backend not recommended (§4.3).

feature: Secondary copies: LAN speed cache, backup cache while gateway is down, geo copy (restic copy)
notes: Cove LocalSpeedVault, Axcient Local Cache (honest: not an independent backup), Veeam Backup Cache. restic cannot dual-write; copy doubles local disk. v1 behaviour is defer-and-retry (flow F18).

feature: Cross-device deduplication
notes: Engine §2.7 / §6: consequence of repo-per-device. Mitigate with aggressive OS/app excludes and zstd.

feature: Cold storage classes
notes: Engine §6: rclone --s3-storage-class applies to every object incl. locks and index; Glacier-class breaks restore/prune.

feature: Vendor-hosted storage pools and partner storage resale
original: Comet, MSP360, Cove, Datto, Axcient, IDrive, Acronis
notes: Commercial arrangements; CryoBackup is bring-your-own storage.

feature: Storage gateway product, cluster manager and replication
notes: Platform features beyond a status page plus orchestrator; rclone serve restic is the gateway.

feature: Client-side encryption (restic AES-256 + Poly1305)
original: Comet, Cove, MSP360, Veeam, Acronis, IDrive

feature: Unique repo password per device, held by the endpoint only in an admin-only file
notes: Engine §2.5: any key holder decrypts the whole repo; per-device repo bounds compromise. Endpoint file ACL per §5.3 (RESTIC_PASSWORD_FILE under ProgramData); DPAPI machine scope is a guess.

feature: Key escrow on the console host (wrapped under a server master key) with MFA-gated, audited reveal
notes: Engine §6: lose the password, lose the repo. Cove Managed Encryption + Security Officer one-time 24 h passphrase; Datto vendor-managed default.

feature: Gateway login rotation and revoke (hot-reload htpasswd)
notes: Revoke on retire or suspected compromise; engine §3.1 bcrypt htpasswd hot-reloaded.

feature: Admin MFA with TOTP and recovery codes
original: Comet, Cove, MSP360, IDrive, Acronis, Veeam, Axcient, Datto
notes: Veeam: enabling MFA breaks basic-auth REST - use tokens. Cove issues a recovery key at 2FA setup.

feature: Roles: owner, admin, operator, read-only
original: Cove, Acronis, Veeam, Datto, Axcient, MSP360
notes: Comet has no read-only admin role and UrBackup rights have no read-only modifier - avoid both.

feature: Audit log (actor, action, object, method web/API, source IP) with fixed retention
notes: Acronis 180 days. Comet audit is a file sink only; UrBackup has none. No file paths in entries.

feature: Scoped, revocable API tokens
notes: Comet personal tokens (26.8.3); Veeam API keys for integrations.

feature: Console bound to loopback or mesh interface by default; public exposure needs auth in front
notes: Project rule.

feature: No telemetry, no phone-home, no CDN-hosted assets
notes: Comet sends mandatory usage/licensing telemetry - avoid. Vendor all JS/fonts; console makes no third-party requests.

feature: Path-free central logs, metrics, alerts, emails and crash reports
notes: HIPAA posture: counts and error classes only; full detail stays in the local agent log. Comet gates filename visibility behind an irreversible flag. Supports BAA-covered-storage-only deployments.

feature: WebAuthn / FIDO2 admin MFA
notes: Comet My Account WebAuthn token.

feature: SSO via OIDC (Entra ID, Google) and optional LDAP
notes: Comet external auth sources LDAP + OIDC; LDAP is the could part.

feature: Granular permission flags
notes: Comet ~25 flags; MSP360 granular admin permissions (Delete users, Delete backup data).

feature: Console hardening: session timeout, login rate limit and lockout, IP allowlist
notes: Comet 30 min default timeout; Axcient 10 bad codes = 1 h lock; IDrive IP login restriction.

feature: Per-customer toggle: operator may browse file names, audited
notes: With escrowed keys the console can ls any snapshot; make browsing opt-in per customer and audit it.

feature: Customer-held key option (no escrow) with consequence warning; two-person reveal gate
notes: Datto deploy-time key choice; IDrive private-key reset wipes data (avoid that cliff); Cove Security Officer role.

feature: Repo key rotation (key add / passwd / remove from admin host)
notes: Engine §2.5: changing the master key needs a new repo; agent cannot run key remove under append-only. Comet vault key rotation hours.

feature: Server identity pinned at enroll (fingerprint carried in the token); optional mTLS or signed agent requests
notes: UrBackup trust-on-first-use server_idents; Cove Agent API mTLS. Certificate failures are the canonical silent outage - pair with the unseen alarm.

feature: Agent tamper resistance (stop/uninstall gated)
notes: Acronis blocks uninstall outside maintenance windows.

feature: Immutability via S3 Object Lock, governance mode
notes: Operator-approved 2026-10-20: "immutable if you enable Object Lock on your bucket". Governance mode only; admin/maintenance host runs prune with bypass-governance-retention; endpoints cannot bypass. Engine §4.5: plausible, untested - MUST lab-test with 1-day retention (locks/, index, prune) before the console shows an Immutable badge. Compliance mode stays skip.

feature: Immutability via S3 Object Lock, compliance mode
notes: Engine §4.5: not safe - lock deletes fail, prune cannot delete, no bypass. MSP360 docs contradict themselves on Object Lock for its own storage.

feature: Snapshot list and tree browse per device (restic snapshots / ls --json)
original: Comet, Cove, MSP360, IDrive, UrBackup, Datto, Axcient

feature: Point-in-time restore (show the machine as of a date)
notes: IDrive snapshot restore is the easiest mental model for end users.

feature: Restore to original or alternate path
notes: Alternate = restic --target, original structure recreated under it (engine §1.12). Windows symlink/SD restore needs LocalSystem privileges.

feature: Overwrite policy (always / if-changed / if-newer / never)
notes: Engine §1.12 restic --overwrite (0.17+).

feature: Restore on the device, started from the console (agent runs restic restore)
notes: Device must be online; restore takes a read lock only. Comet remote restore needs the view-filenames right.

feature: Technician restore without the device: server-side browse and zip/tar download via admin host (restic dump -a zip)
notes: Engine §6 v1 answer to web restore; dump -a zip since 0.18. Needs escrowed key; temp artifacts purged; UrBackup caps ZIP at 4 GB.

feature: Restore a dead device's data onto a new device
notes: Via technician restore or device adoption (flow F21). --private-repos blocks cross-user reads (engine §3.1); Comet Show-items-from-other-devices does not carry over.

feature: Filename search across snapshots incl. deleted files (restic find --json)
notes: Engine §1.9.

feature: Per-file version history
notes: restic find across snapshots. IDrive 30 versions (vs 50 in press, conflicting).

feature: Restore safety options: --verify and dry-run simulate
notes: Engine §1.8, §1.12; verify cannot combine with dry-run.

feature: Live restore progress and cancel
notes: restic restore --json status (engine §1.9).

feature: NTFS permission restore toggle
notes: restic restores the SD according to held privileges; a toggle is not engine-native [unverified].

feature: Self-service end-user restore (web link or local app)
notes: Engine §6: v2 and implies key escrow on the server; v1 is technician-driven.

feature: Restore to cloud or remote location
notes: Comet 26.8.3; implement as restore then rclone copy.

feature: Automated file-restore test on a schedule (sample restore with --verify)
notes: File-level substitute for their boot-screenshot proof; results shown per device.

feature: Mount snapshots as a Windows drive
notes: Engine §1.13: restic mount is FUSE, not available on Windows.

feature: Image, volume and bare-metal restore with boot media
original: Comet, Cove, MSP360, IDrive, Acronis, Datto, Axcient, Veeam, UrBackup
notes: Engine §6: restic is file-level only. UrBackup bridge keeps images; a later separate engine decision.

feature: Restore to VM, virtual-disk export, cloud failover, standby image, boot-screenshot verification
original: Cove, Axcient, Veeam, Datto, MSP360, Acronis
notes: All depend on image-level backups (engine §6).

feature: Device state computed at read time from timestamps + policy (ok / stale / failed / blank / offline, plus pending-first-backup and paused), with explicit grace rules
notes: Axcient Parked/Normal/Warned/Troubled: first window not yet open is Normal, no restore points yet within threshold is Warned. UrBackup avoid: async Lua status lags 30-60 min and goes all-red when the script is missing. Never computed by an alert thread.

feature: SLA threshold per customer (days since last success) with per-device override
notes: Axcient SLA days with device override; IDrive default 2 days; Veeam RPO interval. One number drives colour and alerts.

feature: Device heartbeat with online/offline presence and outdated-agent flag
notes: Acronis offline after 5 missed 1-min checks; Comet Online / Outdated / Offline badges; Cove refresh 15 min active / 8 h idle.

feature: Device unseen for N days state
notes: Comet and Cove have no native unseen alert (third parties CheckCentral / Backup Radar fill the gap); MSP360 offline + no-success is closest.

feature: First-backup grace deadline for a newly enrolled device
notes: Closest: Axcient health grace (Normal until first window opens) but it is not a per-device deadline. Grace expiry raises the stale alarm.

feature: Expected-customers alarm: a configured customer with zero active devices renders as MISSING
notes: Silence at customer level is the canonical failure; same class as the 18-day silent outage.

feature: Console/gateway/storage unreachable raises a prominent banner, never quiet green; freshness stamp on every page
notes: Project fail-loudly rule. Stamp shows last successful state refresh in the operator timezone.

feature: No-data paths are alarms: zero devices, empty poll, partial response
notes: Partial data renders as incomplete with the missing parts named, not as healthy.

feature: Server-judged Missed Run when the expected interval passes without a run

notes: Engine §5.3: LocalSystem already holds backup/restore/security/symlink privileges and can create VSS snapshots; restic 0.19 needs Windows 10 / Server 2016 (§1.2). Comet uses a virtual service account plus an elevator service.

feature: Agent-owned scheduler (no Task Scheduler or cron)
notes: ADR 0001: missed-run catch-up and run-on-wake need an agent-side loop. UrBackup runs the loop server-side; CryoBackup runs it in the agent so it works offline.

feature: Power and session events handled; clean cancel on pre-shutdown
notes: Use x/sys/windows/svc directly (AcceptPowerEvent, AcceptSessionChange, PreShutdown); kardianos/service ignores them (engine §5.1-5.2). Handler must return within 30 s; cancel restic with exit 130 so its lock is released.

feature: restic.exe bundled (not embedded), pinned per agent release, hash-checked at start
notes: Engine §5.9: bundle as a second MSI component; embedding resembles dropper behaviour to EDR. Sign restic.exe with the project identity.

feature: restic child process: job object kill-on-close, no console window, memory cap, cache dir under ProgramData
notes: Engine §5.4 and §1.16: LocalSystem LOCALAPPDATA is the system profile, so set RESTIC_CACHE_DIR explicitly; job object ties restic to the service lifetime.

feature: Parse restic --json (stdout and stderr) and map exit codes
notes: Engine §1.9-1.10: 0 ok, 3 partial, 10/11/12 repo states, 130 cancelled; unknown codes MUST be treated as failure. prune/forget --prune mix text with JSON - run separately.

feature: VSS snapshot by default; per-volume fallback to live read reported as warning; timeout and mount-point options
original: Comet, Cove, MSP360, Veeam, Acronis, Axcient, UrBackup
notes: Engine §1.1: on snapshot failure restic reads the live filesystem, locked files then fail and the run ends exit 3. Surface as warning with the volume named. Comet hint: vssadmin list writers.

feature: Policy pull with last-known-good retention
notes: Agent keeps backing up on the last good policy if the console is unreachable; applies new policy atomically.

feature: Durable local result journal with at-least-once delivery to the console
notes: No result lost while the console is unreachable; console de-duplicates by run ID.

feature: Offline resilience: gateway or console unreachable defers and retries with backoff, never a false failure
notes: Flow F18. Veeam Backup Cache queues locally; Axcient cache failure is a warning only. v1: defer-and-retry plus heartbeat loss makes the device go unseen on the console.

feature: Local logs rotated; full detail stays on the device
notes: HIPAA posture: central systems get counts and error classes only.

feature: No kernel driver, no reboot requirement
notes: Datto change-tracking driver needs one reboot or degrades to one backup/day - avoid. restic needs no driver (change detection is path + size + mtime, engine §1.4).

feature: Tray icon: status colour, check in now, back up now, no-recent-backup nag
notes: Datto tray colour = status; UrBackup NO_RECENT balloon after backup_alert_delay; Comet Close / Lock / Disconnect menu (disconnect stops schedules).

feature: Local CLI (status, enroll, check-in, diagnose)
notes: Comet backup-tool: login status / join-lobby / info device-id.

feature: Resource caps: process priority, GOMAXPROCS, read concurrency, pack size
notes: Axcient BelowNormal default; Veeam throttle-when-busy; engine §1.6: pack size x (connections + 1) temp space.

feature: Windows Event Log source (Info / Warning / Error)
notes: Engine §5.5: good enough for RMM Event Log monitors. Comet event IDs 50-55.

feature: Proxy support (HTTP/HTTPS, SOCKS)
notes: Comet needs websocket-capable proxies; CryoBackup uses plain HTTPS to gateway and console.

feature: Self-update with signature check, staged channel and rollback
original: Cove, MSP360, Datto, Acronis, IDrive, Comet
notes: Engine §5.6: rename-running-exe pattern (minio/selfupdate) works; v1 relies on MSI upgrade via RMM. Judgement call: feasible, so not a skip.

feature: Local end-user UI for browse and restore
notes: v1 is technician-led restore; self-service implies key handling on the endpoint.

feature: Linux and macOS agents
notes: restic runs cross-platform, but scope is Windows workstations.

feature: Non-file engines and application-aware backup (Hyper-V, VMware, SQL, Exchange, system state, NAS agents)
notes: Engine §6: restic does not coordinate writer-specific truncation; workstations are fine, servers dump first. Comet charges per-endpoint add-ons for these.

feature: Block-level change-tracking driver (Backup Accelerator / CBT)
notes: Engine §1.4: restic scans path + size + mtime each run; no driver integration. See no-driver row.

feature: WiX MSI installer with fixed UpgradeCode, rollback, silent install
original: Comet, Cove, Datto, Axcient, IDrive, Veeam
notes: Engine §5.7: WiX ServiceInstall + ServiceControl; avoid unmaintained go-msi. Comet MSI only offered when codesigned.

feature: Authenticode signing of agent, installer and bundled restic.exe
notes: Engine §5.8: EV no longer bypasses SmartScreen; Windows 11 Smart App Control blocks unsigned executables. Azure Artifact Signing, OV or SignPath OSS.

feature: RMM deployment script templates (idempotent, dry-run default)
notes: Comet sample PowerShell: download, run silent with token, delete installer. No param() or CmdletBinding per RMM header rules.

feature: Uninstall and scrub script that also revokes the device server-side
notes: Scrub services, registry, folders, firewall rules, scheduled tasks. Comet uninstall without revoke keeps billing - here it keeps a live gateway login.

feature: In-place upgrade preserving config and state
notes: Via MSI major upgrade pushed by RMM (engine §5.6).

feature: Gateway deployment recipe: systemd unit, TLS, htpasswd, admin-host maintenance loop
notes: Engine §3.4; rclone has no serve-restic service docs.

feature: GPO / Intune deployment guide
notes: Documentation deliverable on top of the MSI. Veeam VSPC discovery rules (AD, network scan, CSV) are the managed-push equivalent (could, later).

feature: Release channels (pilot, stable), force-update selected devices, update window
notes: MSP360 Sandbox vs Public build; Acronis update channel + maintenance window; staged ring prevents fleet-wide regression.

notes: Cove site-scoped executable; UrBackup preconfigured installer download.

feature: Bulk upgrade campaigns with device filters and per-device status
notes: Comet Not seen / Pending / Request made / Update confirmed.

notes: Hardware is out of scope.

notes: Comet Suspend (still billed); IDrive Archive.

notes: MSP360 company Backup Destinations.
